candidate.rationale: DeepViewClone already guarantees res.deep_view() == self.deep_view(); no stronger generic Option<T> postcondition is available.
risks: Repeating the inherited contract is redundant; concrete equality or identity preservation is unsound for arbitrary T.

candidate.rationale: The trait contract already guarantees full Option deep-view equality, including variant and contained deep view. Any expressible shape-preservation condition is redundant, while stronger equality or identity claims are unsound for generic T.
risks: Adding is_some or variant-preservation ensures would merely restate consequences of the inherited contract.
